status: in force before any backtest was published
rule: A price may be published only from a source whose terms allow the read and whose page prints the number. No page reachable in this repository's evidence set prints an NFL betting price, so market_open, market_close and difference_to_market stay empty on every row.
consequence: ROI, CLV and 'cents of edge' are not computable and are not published.

consequence: Opening/closing movement of our own line is measurable today; movement relative to a market is not.
